title: Do you like ___?
goal_hi: Apni pasand aur na-pasand ke baare me sawal aur jawab dena.

forms.negative: I don't like waking up early.
forms.question: Do you like working from home?

pattern.note_hi: Like ke baad noun ya verb+ing.

examples.en: Do you like working from home?
examples.hi: Aapko ghar se kaam karna pasand hai?

examples.en: Do you like tea or coffee?
examples.hi: Aapko chai pasand hai ya coffee?

examples.en: I like watching movies on Sunday.
examples.hi: Mujhe Sunday ko movie dekhna pasand hai.

examples.en: I like working from home, but I miss the office.
examples.hi: Mujhe ghar se kaam karna pasand hai, par office ki yaad aati hai.

examples.en: I don't like waking up early.
examples.hi: Mujhe jaldi uthna pasand nahi hai.

words.example_en: We had a quick chat before the call.
words.example_hi: Call se pehle humne short chat ki.
Paanch minute ka break lete hain.
Main ek baje lunch karta hoon.

dialogue.title: Before the call starts
dialogue.context_hi: Video call do minute pehle shuru hui. Colleague se pre-call small talk.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hi: Hi! Aaj tum jaldi aa gaye.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, I joined early to check my audio.
lines.hi: Haan, audio check karne ke liye jaldi join kiya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Good idea. Do you like working from home?
lines.hi: Achha idea. Tumhe ghar se kaam karna pasand hai?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I like it, but I miss the office.
lines.hi: Pasand hai, par office ki yaad aati hai.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Same here. I like the quiet, but I need a break from my desk.
lines.hi: Mere saath bhi wahi. Shanti pasand hai, par desk se break chahiye.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Let's chat for a minute before the client joins.
lines.hi: Client aane se pehle ek minute baat kar lete hain.

sound_focus.tip_hi: like + verb-ing ko jodo: 'working', 'watching'. Beech me pause mat do.

scenario.setting_hi: Client call se do minute pehle video call par colleague se baat.

turns.prompt_en: You're early. Do you like working from home?
turns.hint_hi: Ghar se kaam pasand hai, par office miss karte ho.
turns.model_en: I like working from home, but I miss the office.

turns.hint_hi: Haan, shanti pasand hai, par desk se break chahiye.
turns.model_en: Yes, I like the quiet, but I need a break from my desk.

turns.prompt_en: What do you usually do before a client call?
turns.hint_hi: Lunch karte ho aur short break lete ho.
turns.model_en: I usually have lunch and take a short break.

turns.prompt_en: Is your office far from here?
turns.hint_hi: Office paas hai, call se pehle colleague se chat karte ho.
turns.model_en: No, my office is close. I usually chat with a colleague before the call.
